nodes.label: Operator (VS Code Claude Code)
nodes.description: Says: "For project Acme, do this and that." One utterance, any session in this repo.

nodes.label: /hq Skill — Front Door
nodes.description: Parses the utterance into project name + intent (park | queue | fire | status). Default intent: park (intake only).

nodes.label: Project Resolver (registry ladder)
nodes.description: Resolves the project name to a real repo path via the registry ladder, then fuzzy-match + operator confirm as the last rung.

nodes.label: Governance Collector
nodes.description: Reads the target repo's state: .pdda-mode, ROUTER/AGENTS, ROADMAP.md, PROJECT/** layout, open MARATHON-PLAN-*.md, gh origin, dup check.

nodes.label: Capability Gate (Tier A/B/C)
nodes.description: Tier A (PDDA+XYZ): full flow, dispatch allowed. Tier B (PDDA only): intake, no dispatch. Tier C (bare repo): plain issue + offer PDDA install.

nodes.label: Intake Writer (issue-first)
nodes.description: Lands the request on the TARGET repo's rails: gh issue → GH-<n>-*.md capture in its 1-INBOX → one-line ROADMAP parking → its own pdda.sh checks.

nodes.label: Dispatch Router (explicit verb only)
nodes.description: Only on an explicit verb. Honors the risk gate (risk >= 3 routes to a human), queue-commitment contract (GH-45), and Tier gating.

nodes.label: Git Pulse PDDA Registry
nodes.description: Primary name→repo resolver: repo · last_install_utc · mode · source_commit · startup_docs. Per-device index of repos on PDDA rails.

nodes.label: XYZ Install Registry
nodes.description: Which repos can RUN driven lanes: install_dir · last_install_utc · tick_version · source_commit · coordinated_repo (GH-62).

nodes.label: Rebalance Registry (read-only)
nodes.description: Aliases + priority/attention metadata. HQ reads only — never writes Rebalance state (mirrors #96 / rebalance-OS#102 seam discipline).

nodes.label: xyz-sync check (drift signal)
nodes.description: Reports whether a target's vendored harness has drifted (recorded vs current tick_version/source_commit). Gates fire (GH-96 Seam #2).

nodes.label: GitHub Issues
nodes.description: The issue is the signal stream; the in-repo capture doc is the execution surface of record.

nodes.label: Target Repo (Acme)
nodes.description: The resolved repo. HQ writes its 1-INBOX capture + ROADMAP parking here; cross-repo writes go through the containment-correct --target-root path (GH-51).

nodes.label: PDDA Checks
nodes.description: Runs against the target's own contract: frontmatter, status-table, roadmap-coverage — so intake passes the target repo's rails, not just this one's.

nodes.label: Marathon Plan Queue
nodes.description: queue verb: append a rated lane to the target's current Marathon Plan (or regenerate via utils/marathon-plan.sh), respecting its collision map.

nodes.label: swarm-preflight → marathon-drive
nodes.description: fire verb: drives a contained lane in the target repo. Refuses on Tier B/C or on xyz-sync drift.
